examples.title: What small task did you ask someone to help with today?
examples.text: I asked my sister to bring lunch so I could rest for a little while. What has helped you?
examples.reply: Having someone handle the dishes made a difference for me. Small practical help counts.

examples.title: Separate logs helped us compare the day
examples.text: We choose each baby's profile before logging. The combined timeline is useful when we talk through the evening together.
examples.reply: We also check the child's name before saving a feed. It helps us avoid mixing the records.

examples.title: What do you take to a baby follow-up visit?
examples.text: We keep the immunization card and a short list of questions together. I add the clinician's measurements afterwards.
examples.reply: A photo of the card and the questions from our care log are useful for us. We confirm unclear entries with our care team.

examples.title: This week: one small moment for yourself
examples.text: An optional, no-pressure challenge: share a tiny moment that felt good, such as a warm drink or a chat with someone you trust.
examples.reply: I sat by the window with tea for five minutes. That was my small win today.
